title: Quality Control Engineer-Mechanical
description:
job Title- Quality control

**Industry:**
Pump / Casting / Fabrication Industry

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Salary:**
₹25,000–₹30,000 Gross per Month

**Department:**
Quality Control (QC)

Qualification- Mechanical Engineer

Job Responsibilities:

* Inspect incoming raw materials and verify quality as per specifications.
* Perform in-process quality inspections during manufacturing.
* Conduct final product inspection before dispatch.
* Ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the production process.
* Inspect casting and fabricated components for defects, dimensions, and surface finish.
* Prepare and maintain quality inspection reports and documentation.
* Identify non-conformities and coordinate with the production team for corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards and customer requirements.
* Use measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, and other inspection tools.
* Support rejection analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

* Diploma / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 3–5 years of experience in Quality Control in the
  **Pump, Casting, or Fabrication Industry**
  .
* Hands-on experience in incoming raw material inspection, in-process inspection, and final product quality control.
* Knowledge of engineering drawings, dimensional inspection, and quality documentation.
* Good observation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile:

* Candidates with relevant experience in pump manufacturing, casting, or fabrication companies will be preferred.
* Must have practical knowledge of quality inspection instruments and manufacturing processes.
* Should be able to coordinate effectively with production and other departments.

**Salary:**
₹25,000–₹30,000 Gross per Month, depending on experience and skills.

title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Amtech Electronics India Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of motor control, automation, power quality, and industrial electronics solutions for a wide range of industries. The company delivers advanced technologies globally, including AC drives, medium voltage drives, soft starters, harmonic filters, and power converters. Amtech provides complete engineered systems and individual components, covering applications engineering, hardware, and software for industrial motor control and power quality markets. With a strong focus on innovation and customer success, Amtech supports organizations in improving efficiency, reliability, and performance through its electrical and automation products.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Electrical Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and developing electrical systems and solutions for motor control, automation, and power quality products. Day-to-day activities include creating detailed electrical schematics, selecting components, performing design calculations, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and safety requirements. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting product development, reviewing designs, and providing technical guidance to junior engineers. The engineer will also participate in prototype testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives for existing products. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong proficiency in Electrical Design and Design Engineering, including creating schematic diagrams and system layouts.
* Solid foundation in Electrical Engineering and practical understanding of electricity and electrical safety principles.
* Experience with Power Distribution systems and related components in industrial or utility environments.
* Knowledge of motor control, drives (AC, medium voltage, high frequency), and power quality solutions is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with relevant industry standards, codes, and best practices for electrical design.
* Ability to use electrical CAD tools and design software for modeling and documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Previous experience in industrial electronics, automation, or power electronics design is an advantage.

title: Sr. Engineer - Design Engineering (Production)
description:
**Position Summary**
Seeking an experienced Product Design Electrical Engineer responsible for the design, development and continuous improvement in injection molding machines. Candidate should have good exposure in Electrical design and knowledge of Servo, VFDs, Sensors and other Electrical components.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**

* Design electrical schematics, control panels, and machine wiring architecture.
* Select and specify electrical components such as PLCs, HMIs, servo drives, VFDs, sensors, SSRs, contactors, and safety devices.
* Develop machine control concepts and interface requirements.
* Ensure compliance with CE, UL, IEC, and relevant machine safety standards.
* Coordinate with mechanical, hydraulic, software, and manufacturing teams during product development.
* Support prototype testing, validation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Prepare electrical BOMs, technical documentation, and product specifications.
* Drive cost reduction, reliability improvements, and design standardization initiatives

**Team**
The candidate will be part of the
**Electrical Design for Product Engineering Team**
, responsible for developing and enhancing electrical systems for injection molding machines. The role involves understanding customer requirements, market trends, and application needs to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions that meet global market expectations.
  
  
The engineer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including mechanical, software, manufacturing, service, and application engineering, while also supporting global engineering teams on product development, standardization, and technical problem-solving activities. Strong communication skills are essential to effectively work with customers, suppliers, and international stakeholders.
  
  
A solid understanding of machine safety concepts and international standards such as CE, IEC, UL, and functional safety requirements is required to ensure compliant and safe machine designs.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/master’s degree in electrical engineering.
* 5-10 years of experience in industrial machine design.
* Strong knowledge of PLC systems, servo motion control and control panel design.
* Proficiency in electrical CAD tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, Aucotec).
* Understanding of machine safety circuits, risk assessment, and EMC requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering
  
  
**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

title: Security Control Assessment Specialist
description:
**Department:**
Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad/GiftCity
  
  
**Description**
We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.

**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
Essential Skills & Experience
  
  

* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800-53.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Desirable Skills & Experience
  
  

* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits & Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.*

* Health & Financial Security:

+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off & Flexibility:

+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.

* Our Culture:

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Architect)
description:
**Department:**
Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad/GiftCity
  
  
**Description**
Trading Technologies is in the middle of a massive infrastructure shift within the high-stakes world of capital markets. We’re removing our legacy VMware datacenter, upgrading our Red Hat ecosystem, and modernizing our AWS footprint to support low latency, high-performance trading systems. To pull this off, we’re restructuring our engineering org into dedicated Cloud and Platform teams.
  
  
If you are looking to gain deep, hands-on experience building the highly robust, low-latency platforms that power capital markets, this is your chance.
  
  
We need a Senior Platform Engineer to join the new Platform Team. Your main goal? Make life incredibly easy for our developers while maintaining the ironclad reliability our industry demands. We want to stop treating infrastructure as a ticketing system and start treating our platform as a product. To do that, we are making
**Backstage**
the center of our universe, building it out as the core data model and source of truth for all of our platform engineering operations
  
  
Role will be expected to be on call as part of the standard on call rotations.
  
  
**What Will You Be Involved With?**

* Own Backstage: You will architect and build out Backstage so it acts as our central software catalog, holding all the metadata, ownership data, and telemetry for our high-performance engineering systems.
* Modernize Deployments: Our current deployment pipelines need an overhaul. You’ll help us move toward modern practices (GitOps, containerization, progressive delivery) so developers can ship code without friction—and without breaking critical financial workflows.
* Fix the DevEx: Build "golden paths" and self-service tools that abstract away the complexity of AWS. If a developer needs infrastructure, they shouldn't have to wait for someone to click buttons.
* SRE in Capital Markets: Bring your deep Linux SRE expertise to an environment where microseconds matter. You’ll support the upgrade and optimization of our Red Hat (RHEL) environments while we actively migrate latency-sensitive workloads off VMware and into a modernized AWS setup.
* Code the Infrastructure: Write clean, highly optimized Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, etc.) to ensure everything we build is reproducible, version-controlled, and tuned for maximum performance.
* Pipelines: create and improve the pipelines to drive quality, and ensure that what we deliver does not put our services at risk.

**What Will You Bring to the Table?**

* Experience: 7+ years primarily focused on Platform Engineering, SRE, or modern DevOps.
* Platform & DevEx Focus: You genuinely care about the developer experience. You have real experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), and ideally, you've gotten your hands dirty configuring Backstage plugins and data models.
* Linux / SRE Chops: You are a Linux expert, specifically with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). You know how to tune the OS for performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and scale systems under heavy load.
* Cloud Modernization: You know your way around AWS and have a track record of moving workloads out of legacy on-prem datacenters (especially VMware) into the cloud.
* Deployment Mastery: You are highly familiar with modern CI/CD, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux).
* Scripting: You can write solid automation and tooling in Python, Go, TypeScript (helpful for Backstage), or Bash.

****Bonus Points****

* You’ve contributed to open-source tools or built custom Backstage plugins.
* You know how to integrate complex telemetry (Datadog, Prometheus, etc.) directly into developer portals.
* Previous experience in Fintech, trading, or capital markets is great, but absolutely not required—we will teach you the domain.

**What We Bring To The Table**

* TT is a company in an exciting growth phase, having benefited from new ownership and investment over the last 5 years.
* A compelling suite of products, and plans for significant product development in 2026 and onwards.
* An established and mature core product offering, with a well known and well respected brand identity.
* A dynamic and positive company culture that fosters employee growth and rewards results. Comprehensive benefits package.

***Competitive Benefits & Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.*

* Health & Financial Security:

+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off & Flexibility:

+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work-Life Support & Resources:

+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness & Lifestyle Perks:

+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:

+ Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. expected operating pattern is:Understand the result.Build the plan.Get the required inputs.Move the work.Resolve blockers.Escalate what genuinely requires a decision.Check the final result.Close the loop.For important assignments, you should always know:• What outcome is expected• Who is responsible• What information is missing• What dependencies exist• What deadline applies• What could block title: Senior Design Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Design Engineer

**Company:**
EAC Engineers

**Location:**
Sanand GIDC, Ahmedabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

Role purpose

Lead the mechanical design and engineering of pressure vessels, shell-and-tube heat exchangers and related process equipment. Ensure designs are safe, compliant with applicable project requirements, practical to manufacture and delivered on time.

The role involves taking engineering ownership from enquiry review through detailed design, customer approval, fabrication support and final documentation.

Key responsibilities

**1. Technical review and proposal support**

* Review customer enquiries, datasheets, specifications and drawings to identify design requirements, exclusions and technical risks.
* Support Sales with preliminary sizing, material selection, estimated weights, technical offers and clarification responses.
* Identify missing information and resolve technical queries before detailed engineering begins.

**2. Equipment design and calculations**

* Prepare and review mechanical design calculations for pressure vessels and shell-and-tube heat exchangers.
* Apply relevant codes, standards and customer specifications, including ASME Section VIII and TEMA where applicable.
* Evaluate design conditions, corrosion allowances, materials, nozzle reinforcement, supports, lifting arrangements and applicable external loads.
* Coordinate thermal design requirements for heat exchangers and verify that mechanical designs reflect the approved thermal datasheet.
* Support the engineering of dryers, scrubbers, dampeners, storage tanks, skids and associated piping within the assigned scope.

**3. Drawings and engineering documentation**

* Prepare, check and release general arrangement drawings, fabrication drawings, nozzle schedules, bills of materials and design reports.
* Ensure consistency between calculations, drawings, BOMs and customer requirements.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision history and controlled issue of approved documents.
* Prepare final as-built drawings and engineering documents required for the manufacturing record dossier.

**4. Customer and inspection coordination**

* Handle technical discussions with customers, consultants and inspection agencies.
* Close drawing and calculation comments promptly and track approval status.
* Coordinate with Quality and the Authorized Inspector on applicable design documentation and code requirements.
* Assess the technical, cost and delivery impact of customer changes and communicate these before implementation.

**5. Manufacturing and procurement support**

* Work with Production to ensure designs account for fabrication methods, welding access, assembly, inspection and maintenance.
* Provide Purchase with clear material specifications and review technical offers for bought-out items.
* Resolve shop-floor queries and assess proposed deviations or substitutions through the applicable approval process.
* Identify opportunities to reduce material waste, rework and manufacturing cost while meeting design requirements.

**6. Planning and team leadership**

* Own the engineering schedule across active orders and allocate work to engineers and draughtspersons.
* Review and approve team deliverables within delegated authority.
* Track engineering progress, overdue approvals and design-related risks.
* Develop calculation templates, drawing standards and checking procedures.
* Mentor the team and coordinate engineering priorities with Sales, Purchase, Production and Quality.
* Maintain engineering deliverables and progress records in the company’s ERP/Odoo system.

Qualifications and experience

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent relevant qualification.
* **Senior Design Engineer:**
  Typically 6–10 years of relevant equipment design experience, with the ability to independently execute assigned projects.
* Relevant experience with a manufacturer of pressure vessels, heat exchangers or comparable fabricated process equipment is essential.
* Experience working in an ASME U-Stamp manufacturing environment is strongly preferred.

Required technical skills

* Practical knowledge of pressure vessel and heat exchanger mechanical design.
* Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII Division 1 and TEMA; familiarity with related material and welding requirements.
* Proficiency in
  **PV Elite or equivalent pressure vessel design software**
  .
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to prepare or review fabrication drawings.
* Understanding of material selection, fabrication tolerances, welding, NDE and pressure testing.
* Ability to interpret customer specifications and communicate technical decisions clearly.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

: NDT Level III Engineer / Specialist (Oil & Gas Domain)

**Location**
: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Base Location)

**Employment Type**
: Full-time, Permanent

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**

Arham Oil Gas Products and Services Pvt. Ltd. (established in 2013 by petroleum engineers from IIT ISM Dhanbad) is an ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 certified pioneer in advanced industrial cleaning, robotics, and hazardous waste management. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, we combine heavy engineering execution with deep-tech automation to drive safety and environmental sustainability in the oil and gas sector. We specialize in cutting-edge Robotic Non-Man Entry Tank Cleaning, online mechanical desludging, and oily sludge reprocessing for major public and private sector giants like ONGC, IOCL, and MRPL. As a rapidly growing core-sector leader with an expanding international footprint in the Middle East and GCC regions, we are actively integrating automated inspection frameworks into our high-tech robotic execution pipelines. For senior technical professionals, Arham offers a highly collaborative and professionally driven environment to lead high-value refinery assets and establish global safety benchmarks. We are currently scaling our technical operations and looking for visionary experts to join our team in Ahmedabad.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

• Job Title: NDT Level III Engineer / Specialist (Oil & Gas Domain)

• Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Base Location)

• Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

• Experience Required: 8 - 15 Years (With a minimum of 3-5 years of active experience as a certified Level III professional)

• Core Technical Requirement: Mandatory expertise and hands-on validation experience across all major NDT methods (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, and TOFD).

**JOB DESCRIPTION & ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

As the core technical authority for NDT and Asset Integrity operations, you will oversee inspection methods, approve NDT procedures, and ensure full alignment between client requirements and global engineering codes.

• Procedure Management: Establish, review, evaluate, and formally approve NDT procedures (UT, PAUT, TOFD, MT, PT, VT) in strict compliance with international codes like ASME, API, and ASTM.

• Technical Authority: Interpret complex inspection data, verify NDT reports, and provide final engineering clearances or structural health recommendations for refinery tanks and pipelines.

• Quality Assurance: Conduct on-site technical audits to monitor NDT activities and ensure flawless compliance with PSU client specifications and ISO standards.

• Training & Mentorship: Train, evaluate, and formally certify internal Level-I and Level-II NDT technicians within the organization.

• Robotics Collaboration: Work closely with our core R&D and Robotics engineering teams to integrate digital inspection logging frameworks into automated robotic crawlers.

• Client Interface: Act as the primary technical interface during client meetings, third-party inspections (TPI), and high-level technical audits.

title: Principal Engineer (Conveyance – Water & Wastewater Networks)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means delivering efficient, resilient, and future-ready water supply and wastewater conveyance systems that support urban growth and environmental sustainability.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering large-scale water and wastewater network solutions, driving technical excellence and innovation across projects.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer – Conveyance, you will act as a subject matter expert and technical lead for the planning, modelling, and design of water distribution and wastewater collection systems. You will guide teams on complex assignments while remaining actively involved in critical technical deliverables. You will collaborate within a multicultural, high‑performing engineering environment and contribute to achieving project targets related to quality, schedules, technical rigor, and client satisfaction.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in the design and planning of water supply and wastewater conveyance networks.
* Lead and review development of hydraulic models (steady state and extended period simulations) for large-scale systems.
* Oversee master planning studies, including

+ Demand forecasting and load assessment
+ Land-use analysis
+ System capacity assessment and gap analysis

* Drive network optioneering and optimisation, ensuring cost-effective and sustainable solutions.
* Lead preparation and review of

+ Capital investment plans and phasing strategies
+ Implementation roadmaps for network expansion/upgrades

* Review and guide engineering design deliverables, including

+ Pipeline sizing and network layouts
+ Hydraulic calculations and system controls
+ Pumping systems and rising mains

* Provide expertise in pumping systems, including system curves, pump selection, operational strategies, and integration with networks.
* Ensure effective integration with treatment plants, reservoirs, and pump stations.
* Perform and lead technical QA/QC reviews of models, calculations, reports, and drawings.
* Support Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC projects, including constructability inputs and contractor coordination.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, civil, electrical, BIM) to ensure aligned delivery.
* Prepare and review technical reports, design basis documents, and client presentations.
* Act as a key technical interface with clients and stakeholders, supporting reviews, approvals, and technical discussions.
* Support bid/proposal development, including methodology, technical inputs, and effort estimation.
* Identify and manage technical risks, providing mitigation strategies.
* Mentor engineers and support development of technical capability within the team.
* Promote adoption of digital tools, modelling best practices, and data-driven workflows.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Hydraulic Modelling WaterGEMS & SewerGEMS,
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWorks ICM & InfoWorks WS Pro
* GIS ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Design & Coordination Civil 3D, Navisworks
* Coordination/ Clash Detection Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority with ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capability.
* Confident communicator with effective client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in multidisciplinary environments.
* High attention to quality, accuracy, and technical integrity.
* Mentorship-oriented, with focus on developing team capability.
* Committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in water and wastewater conveyance planning and design.
* Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, master planning, and detailed design of water distribution and sewer networks.
* Proven ability to lead complex modelling studies and infrastructure planning projects.
* Hands-on experience with

+ Water distribution networks
+ Wastewater collection systems (gravity + rising mains)
+ Pumping and transmission systems

* Experience in optioneering, system optimisation, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Experience in multidisciplinary infrastructure projects and coordination.
* Exposure to Design‑Build / EPC delivery models is an advantage.
* Experience in technical reviews, QA/QC, and mentoring engineers.
* Strong familiarity with international design standards and best practices.
* Experience in technical proposal preparation and client engagement.
* Awareness of BIM-enabled design environments is desirable

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)

**Preferred Attributes**

* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) / Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Experience in international projects and global delivery frameworks
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, client‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Counter Executive / Senior Counter Executive serves as the first point of contact for walk-in customers at Blue Dart retail counters, delivering a professional, efficient and customer-centric service experience. The role is responsible for assisting customers with shipment bookings, service enquiries, documentation, payment processing and shipment tracking while ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience.
  
  
Reporting to the Branch Operations Head or Service In-charge, the incumbent represents the Blue Dart brand through courteous customer interactions, operational accuracy and service excellence. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), retail revenue growth and customer retention by consistently delivering high-quality service and promoting appropriate logistics solutions.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To provide an exceptional customer experience at Blue Dart retail counters by accurately processing customer shipments, addressing enquiries, promoting relevant services and ensuring efficient counter operations while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, operational accuracy and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Customer Service & Retail Counter Operations**

* Welcome walk-in customers professionally and provide prompt, courteous and personalised service.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate Blue Dart products and services.
* Accept, process and book domestic and international shipments in accordance with established operational procedures.
* Assist customers with shipment documentation, packaging guidance and service-related enquiries.
* Ensure accurate data entry and transaction processing within operational systems.

**Shipment Booking & Transaction Management**

* Verify shipment details, documentation and packaging prior to acceptance.
* Generate shipment documentation, labels, invoices and customer receipts accurately.
* Process cash, digital and other approved payment methods in accordance with company policies.
* Maintain complete accuracy in shipment booking, documentation and billing activities.
* Ensure timely closure of all counter transactions and daily operational records.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Management**

* Deliver a consistently positive customer experience aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
* Resolve customer queries, concerns and complaints professionally or escalate them appropriately.
* Provide shipment status updates and assist customers with tracking and delivery-related enquiries.
* Promote customer confidence through clear communication and proactive service.
* Build strong customer relationships that contribute to repeat business, customer loyalty and improved Net Promoter Score (NPS).

**Retail Sales & Brand Representation**

* Promote Blue Dart's products, value-added services and packaging solutions based on customer needs.
* Identify opportunities to maximise retail revenue through effective customer engagement.
* Maintain a professional appearance and ensure the retail counter reflects Blue Dart's brand standards at all times.
* Support local customer engagement initiatives and promotional campaigns where applicable.
* Represent the organisation with integrity, professionalism and a customer-first mindset during every customer interaction.

**Cash Management & Financial Controls**

* Receive and process customer payments through cash, cards, digital payment modes and other approved channels.
* Ensure accurate billing, receipt generation and reconciliation of all customer transactions.
* Maintain complete accountability for cash collections, petty cash (where applicable) and daily financial transactions.
* Perform daily cash balancing, counter closing and submission of collections in accordance with company procedures.
* Report discrepancies, shortages or irregularities immediately to the reporting manager.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of financial transactions and customer payment information.

**Counter Administration & Operational Compliance**

* Ensure the retail counter is maintained in a clean, organised and customer-friendly manner at all times.
* Maintain adequate stock of shipment stationery, packaging material, labels and other counter consumables.
* Ensure timely replenishment of operational supplies to avoid disruption in customer service.
* Adhere to company policies, operational SOPs, statutory guidelines and security procedures applicable to retail operations.
* Maintain accurate operational records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.

**Service Quality & Brand Excellence**

* Deliver service in line with Blue Dart's customer experience and brand standards during every customer interaction.
* Contribute towards achieving branch-level customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) targets.
* Demonstrate professionalism, positive attitude and customer-first behaviour while handling all customer interactions.
* Ensure first-time-right processing of shipments to minimise operational errors and customer complaints.
* Support local initiatives aimed at enhancing customer experience, retail business growth and service quality.

**Operational Coordination**

* Coordinate with Branch Operations, Customer Service and Operations teams to ensure seamless shipment processing.
* Follow up on shipment-related queries and support timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Assist in managing peak-hour customer traffic while maintaining service quality standards.
* Support new product launches, promotional campaigns and retail initiatives introduced by the organisation.
* Escalate operational issues, customer concerns or system-related challenges to the reporting manager in a timely manner.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Higher Secondary (12th Pass) is mandatory.
* Graduate in any discipline is preferred.
* Certification in Customer Service, Retail Operations or Computer Applications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in customer service, retail operations, front office, banking, courier, logistics or hospitality.
* Experience in handling customer interactions, billing, cash transactions and point-of-sale operations.
* Exposure to shipment booking, documentation or retail service environments will be preferred.
* Experience in using computer-based business applications, email and operational systems.
* Ability to communicate professionally in English and the local language, with strong interpersonal and customer handling skills

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**

* Customer Service & Relationship Management
* Shipment Booking & Documentation
* Cash Handling & Daily Reconciliation
* Billing & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations
* Retail Counter Operations
* Computer Applications (MS Office, Email & Internet)
* Shipment Tracking & Operational Systems
* Data Entry & Documentation Accuracy
* Basic Sales & Product Promotion
* Operational Compliance & Record Management

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer First Mindset
* Excellent Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Professional Etiquette & Grooming
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity & Accountability
* Cash Handling Discipline
* Problem Solving & Conflict Resolution
* Teamwork & Collaboration
* Adaptability & Learning Agility
* Time Management & Multitasking

Customer satisfaction; Net Promoter Score (NPS); Positive customer feedback; Professional customer interactions

Accuracy of shipment bookings; Transaction accuracy; First-time-right processing; Counter turnaround time

Here is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for a
**Clinical Pathologist**
, tailored for a diagnostic laboratory, hospital-attached lab, or multi-specialty clinical network.
  
  
Job Title: Consultant Clinical Pathologist
  
  
**Department:**
Laboratory Medicine & Clinical Pathology
  
  
**Reports To:**
Head of Pathology / Laboratory Director / Medical Director
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time / Consultant / Shift-based
  
  

* Job Purpose

The Clinical Pathologist is responsible for overseeing and validating diagnostic laboratory testing across Clinical Biochemistry, Hematology, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and Blood Bank/Transfusion Medicine. The role ensures diagnostic accuracy, strict internal and external quality control (IQC/EQAS), compliance with laboratory accreditation standards, and direct diagnostic consultation with referring clinicians.
  
  

* Key Duties & Responsibilities
* Diagnostic Reporting & Interpretation
* Analyze, interpret, and sign off on test results across Clinical Biochemistry, Hematology, Serology, Immunoassay, Urinalysis, and Body Fluid Analysis.
* Review peripheral blood smears, bone marrow aspirates/biopsies, and abnormal blood counts.
* Conduct and interpret specialized laboratory tests (e.g., hemoglobin electrophoresis, coagulation profiles, autoimmune panels).
* Provide clinical consultation to treating physicians regarding test selection, diagnostic interpretation, and follow-up recommendations.
* Quality Assurance & Regulatory Compliance
* Supervise Daily Internal Quality Control (IQC) and External Quality Assessment Schemes (EQAS / PT samples).
* Ensure strict adherence to laboratory accreditation and regulatory guidelines (e.g., NABL, NABH, CAP, ISO 15189, CLIA).
* Perform troubleshooting for quality control out-of-bounds, instrument calibrations, and assay validations.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for audits, equipment maintenance, and safety protocols.
* Lab Operations & Technical Supervision
* Oversee daily laboratory workflows, sample processing, specimen rejection protocols, and turnaround times (TAT).
* Supervise, train, and mentor Medical Laboratory Technologists (MLTs), junior pathologists, and technical staff on standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Participate in evaluating and validating new diagnostic kits, automated analyzers, and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).
* Ensure strict bio-risk management, infection control, and chemical/biological waste disposal standards.
* Required Qualifications & Certifications
* Education:

+ MD / DNB in Pathology / Clinical Pathology from a recognized medical institution.
+ DCP (Diploma in Clinical Pathology) may be considered depending on seniority and role requirements.

* Licensure & Registration: Valid Medical Council Registration/License.
* Experience:

+ 0-3 years for Junior Consultant / Associate Pathologist.
+ 5+ years for Senior Consultant / Laboratory Quality Manager.
+ Exposure to NABL / CAP accredited laboratory environments is highly desirable.

* Key Skills & Competencies
* Technical Expertise: Hematology smear interpretation, automated analyzer troubleshooting, LIMS proficiency, bone marrow interpretation, and quality management systems (QMS).
* Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of ISO 15189, NABL / CAP guidelines, bio-safety standards, and IQC/EQAS interpretation.
* Soft Skills: High analytical precision, effective inter-departmental communication, leadership, and crisis management.

description:

* Develop and implement supplier improvement plans using APQP, PPAP, and other advanced quality tools to elevate supplier performance

Above all, you're a quality-driven professional with deep expertise in supplier development, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence and coach suppliers toward sustained performance improvement. We'd also imagine that you are/have:

You'll also be available for travelling up to 120 days per year.

title: Consultant Critical Care - (ICU & Emergency Care)
description:
Here is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for a
**Critical Care Consultant**
(Intensivist), designed for a multi-specialty hospital, tertiary care center, or ICU setting.
  
  
Job Title: Consultant - Critical Care Medicine (Intensivist)
  
  
**Department:**
Critical Care & Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
  
  
**Reports To:**
Head of Critical Care / Medical Director
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time / Shift-based / Consultant
  
  

* Job Purpose

The Critical Care Consultant is responsible for providing expert, comprehensive care to critically ill patients admitted to the ICU (MICU, SICU, CCU, or Neuro-ICU). The candidate will lead the multidisciplinary ICU team, manage organ failure and life support systems, oversee patient triage, enforce safety and infection control protocols, and ensure high-quality, compassionate clinical outcomes.
  
  

* Key Duties & Responsibilities
* Clinical Care & Patient Management
* Provide immediate, advanced medical management for critically ill patients requiring organ support, advanced mechanical ventilation, hemodynamic monitoring, and invasive procedures.
* Perform bed-side diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, including endotracheal intubation, central venous & arterial catheterization, tracheostomy, chest tube insertion, point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS), and bronchoscopy.
* Conduct twice-daily comprehensive multidisciplinary ICU rounds to review treatment plans, lab results, imaging, and medication adjustments.
* Triage ICU admissions and discharges efficiently in coordination with emergency and surgical departments.
* Facilitate open, empathetic communication with patient families regarding prognosis, care goals, end-of-life options, and DNR decisions.
* ICU Protocols, Quality & Safety
* Develop, update, and enforce evidence-based clinical protocols (e.g., sepsis bundles, ventilator-associated pneumonia prevention, sedation/weaning protocols).
* Monitor and enforce strict infection control practices and antibiotic stewardship within the unit.
* Participate in ICU mortality and morbidity reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and hospital accreditation audits (e.g., NABH, JCI).
* Team Leadership & Supervision
* Supervise and mentor junior doctors (Registrars, Residents, Fellows), ICU nurses, respiratory therapists, and clinical pharmacists.
* Conduct regular training sessions on Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), airway management, and ICU monitoring devices.
* Coordinate effectively with primary admitting consultants, surgeons, and sub-specialists to ensure cohesive patient management.
* Required Qualifications & Certifications
* Education:

+ MD / DNB / MS in Anaesthesiology, General Medicine, Pulmonary Medicine, or Emergency Medicine.
+ Sub-specialty qualification in Critical Care: DM / DNB in Critical Care Medicine, IDCCM, EDIC, or equivalent Fellowship.

* Licensure & Certifications:

+ Valid State / National Medical Council Registration.
+ Active ACLS / BLS Certification.

* Experience:

+ 0-3 years post-fellowship experience for Junior Consultant level.
+ 5+ years for Senior Consultant level (experience running closed ICU models preferred).

* Key Skills & Competencies
* Clinical Expertise: Mechanical ventilation strategies, hemodynamic stabilization, renal replacement therapy (CRRT/HD), POCUS/ECHO in ICU.
* Core Competencies: Rapid decision-making under stress, leadership, effective crisis management, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Soft Skills: High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills for difficult family consultations, and ethical decision-making.

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

title: OEE Systems & Manufacturing Performance Specialist
description:
*Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.*
*Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.*
*Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.*
*This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.*
**Introduction**
We are looking for an
**OEE Systems & Manufacturing Performance Specialist**
to support and continuously improve our OEE platform across our manufacturing sites. In this role, you will help ensure reliable system performance, accurate production data, and useful insights that drive operational improvements.
  
  
The role can be located at any of our main Consumables manufacturing sites. We support hybrid ways of working, while regular presence at the local manufacturing site is expected to encourage collaboration and relationship building.
  
  
**Team you belong to**
You will join an international manufacturing environment focused on digitalization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You will collaborate with manufacturing teams, internal IT, application support, software suppliers, and manufacturing analytics teams. You will report to the Director, Manufacturing Execution Processes.
  
  
In this role, you will connect factory operations with technical teams, helping turn systems and manufacturing data into value for the business.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the day-to-day administration and operational support of the OEE platform across manufacturing sites, acting as a trainer and subject-matter expert for factory users and key stakeholders
* Monitor and manage data flows from production equipment and shop-floor systems into the OEE platform, analytics, and reporting solutions, ensuring accurate and reliable manufacturing data
* Coordinate ERP integration with OEE and MES systems, including production-order and operation-confirmation data flows, interface testing, validation, monitoring, and troubleshooting
* Coordinate the onboarding and connection of new production equipment, including requirements definition, testing, validation, documentation, and handover to operations
* Troubleshoot system, software, interface, configuration, and data-quality issues in collaboration with internal IT teams and external software suppliers, while ensuring consistent and correct OEE system usage
* Analyze availability, performance, and quality losses to identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to common standards, training materials, system enhancements, manufacturing digitalization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Management, Information Systems, Automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* You understand manufacturing operations, production processes, equipment behavior, and production losses, with experience in OEE, MES, manufacturing data systems, industrial digitalization, or similar production-performance solutions.
* You understand equipment connectivity and data flows between machines, shop-floor solutions, ERP systems, business applications, and reporting platforms, including interface testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* You have strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills and are comfortable resolving technical and data-quality issues with IT teams and external software suppliers
* You are a confident communicator and trainer who can work effectively with technical and operational stakeholders in an international, multi-site environment, and you have professional working proficiency in English.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools, Lean manufacturing, root-cause analysis, industrial automation, PLC, OPC, IoT, edge technologies, SQL, or machine integration is considered an advantage

**What's In It For You**

* An inspiring purpose - Enabling sustainable modern life. Minerals and metals are the backbone of essential functions in the modern world. However, there's a pressing need for more sustainable solutions to collect and process them. At Metso, you get to be part of transforming the industry and making a positive change.
* A thriving culture - We are committed to developing an inclusive culture that enables everyone to do their best and reach their full potential. A culture that is courageous, compelling, and caring, and unites our people to build a sustainable future together.
* Extensive learning opportunities - Ongoing growth dialogues, internal mobility, mentoring programs, education assistance, ambitious projects, and global opportunities.
* Worldwide support - Leverage our network of peers across the world, offering valuable assistance. We get things done together, through open and honest communication.

description:
**Company Description**
Anantara Atelier is a design-focused studio dedicated to elevating interiors with global inspiration and a strong emphasis on serenity and balance. Guided by the philosophy of “Infusing Zen into Design,” the company creates spaces that blend aesthetic appeal with a calm, mindful atmosphere. Its work centers on transforming interiors into harmonious environments that support wellbeing and comfort. Team members collaborate closely to bring thoughtful, detail-oriented design solutions to clients. Applicants can expect a creative, quality-driven workplace that values innovation and refined interior experiences.

**Role Description**
We are seeking a skilled Lead Generation Specialist with hands-on expertise in both
**Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads**
. The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and monitoring paid advertising campaigns to generate qualified leads for our interior design and turnkey projects.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, lead generation strategies, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.Key Responsibilities

**1. Meta Ads Management**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
* Develop effective audience targeting strategies based on demographics, interests, locations, and buyer intent.
* Run lead generation, website conversion, remarketing, and retargeting campaigns.
* Test different ad creatives, copy, audiences, and campaign objectives to improve performance.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets to achieve lower cost per qualified lead.

**2. Google Ads Management**

* Plan and manage Google Search, Display, and other relevant Google Ads campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent search terms relevant to interior design and turnkey interior services.
* Optimize bidding strategies, ad copies, audience targeting, and campaign structure.
* Monitor search terms, negative keywords, conversion tracking, and landing page performance.
* Improve lead quality while maintaining an efficient cost per acquisition.

**3. Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Develop and implement digital strategies to generate consistent, high-quality leads.
* Focus on lead generation for 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, and premium residential interior projects.
* Understand the target audience, customer journey, and factors influencing purchase decisions.
* Coordinate with the sales team to track lead quality, follow-ups, site visits, and booking conversions.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.

**4. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS), where measurable.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Use Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager as required.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking and identify areas for campaign improvement.
* Allocate budgets based on campaign performance and business priorities.

**5. Creative & Marketing Coordination**

* Work with the internal design and content team to develop effective ad creatives, videos, reels, and campaign concepts.
* Provide creative briefs based on campaign performance and audience insights.
* Suggest new marketing strategies, offers, and campaigns to improve lead generation.
* Stay updated with digital advertising trends, platform changes, and competitor activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing and paid lead generation.
* Strong practical expertise in both
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Proven experience generating leads for real estate, interior design, home interiors, architecture, or other high-value services is preferred.
* Good understanding of audience segmentation, remarketing, conversion tracking, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion APIs is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed decisions.
* Understanding of landing pages, lead forms, keyword research, and conversion rate optimization.
* Ability to manage advertising budgets and deliver measurable results.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with the sales and creative teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified leads generated per month.
* Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead.
* Lead quality and relevance to the company's services.
* Lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.
* Campaign performance and advertising budget efficiency.
* Accuracy of tracking, reporting, and performance analysis.
* Consistency in achieving agreed monthly lead generation targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Can independently manage Meta and Google Ads without relying entirely on an external marketing agency.
* Understands the difference between generating a high volume of leads and generating leads that actually convert into business.
* Is confident in analyzing campaign data and making performance-driven decisions.
* Takes ownership of advertising budgets, lead quality, and campaign results.
* Is proactive, creative, analytical, and focused on business growth.

* **Strong understanding of US GAAP and US accounting practices.**
* **Experience with AP, AR, journal entries, and general ledger activities.**
* **Strong knowledge of bank reconciliations and month-end closing.**
* **Experience preparing or reviewing financial reports and balance sheet accounts.**
* **Proficiency in QuickBooks Online/Desktop or similar accounting software.**
* **Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.**
* **Ability to independently manage accounting activities and deadlines.**
* **Good written and verbal communication skills.**
* **Ability to work with multiple clients and handle competing priorities.**
* **A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.**
* **Prior experience reviewing work or guiding junior accountants is an advantage.**

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office

Monday to Friday

This role specifically requires
**hands-on US Accounting experience**
. Candidates without relevant US Accounting experience or those seeking Work From Home opportunities should not apply.

Please apply only if you meet the essential requirements listed above.

title: Housing | IT Executive
description:
**About ZURU**
ZURU is a reimagination company. We look for categories that have stood still, then we build next-generation products and brands that set the new standard. ZURU Toys is reimagining play. ZURU Edge is reinventing everyday consumer brands. Rhodes Pet Science is reimagining pet science. ZURU Tech is leading the next building revolution.
  
  
ZURU started in 2003 with two brothers from New Zealand, and we're still founder-owned and operated today. Since then we've become the world's second-biggest privately held toy company, and nearly half of all Gen Y and Gen Z households with kids in the US own a ZURU product. Today we're 5,000 people in 34 offices, selling into more than 150 markets, backed by over 100 acres of fully automated manufacturing. And we're only getting started.
  
  
**Experience: 2–3 Years Experience**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to end users, and install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.
* Troubleshoot Windows OS, Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, and other business applications.
* Manage user accounts, email accounts, and permissions in Microsoft 365 and Active Directory.
* Configure and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and network connectivity issues; monitor network devices such as switches, routers, firewalls, and access points.
* Perform software installation, updates, and antivirus management.
* Maintain IT asset inventory, coordinate with vendors for warranty claims/repairs, and create technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Support IT infrastructure projects, office setup activities, and ensure compliance with IT security policies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Diploma or equivalent also acceptable).
* 2–3 years of experience in IT Support, IT Operations, or Infrastructure Support.
* Strong skills in Windows 10/11 Administration, Microsoft 365 Administration, and hardware/software troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Experience with IT asset management and helpdesk/ticketing tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills with a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager, Fortinet or Sophos networking products, and backup/endpoint security solutions.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified (M365, Azure Fundamentals), CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or Fortinet NSE/FCA.
* Experience supporting 100+ users.

**Who Thrives At ZURU**
This isn't a 9-to-5. We move fast, think big and set goals most companies would call impossible, then go after them. The people who thrive here are entrepreneurs at heart. They own their work, chase bold ideas and never stop raising the bar.
  
  
At ZURU, you drive your career, and we give you the platform to take it as far as you can. There are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else, and you'll be surrounded by talented people who make things happen. We're a true meritocracy: we reward impact, not tenure.
  
  
**How We Work**
Big ideas happen when great people work side by side, so we're office-first by design. Being together means faster collaboration, sharper decisions and stronger teams, and it's where the real learning happens. Some flexibility may be available depending on the role, location and business needs, but most roles are office-based.
  
  
Want to see what life at ZURU really looks like? Follow @LifeatZURU on Instagram or visit www.zuru.com.
  
  
ZURU – Reimagining tomorrow 🚀
  
  
ZURU is on a quest to reimagine tomorrow, now spanning three core divisions — ZURU Toys, ZURU Edge and ZURU Tech.
